text: Objective panel and popups truncate text at tick ~960: objective 4 hint reads 'Gather 50 wood, then press' (cut off, key not visible); top toast 'Objective complete: Create or'; popup 'Create or join a nat'. Expected full text or wrapping.
Found-settlement refusal says 'Open ground lies about 280 to the west' but nothing on screen shows which way west is (no compass, no map marker); player must guess. tick ~3650

After founding, the settlement's world label ('0 here, 1/8 residents') renders huge across the top of the screen and a pawn name label ('...antha Brown') overlaps the Objective panel; both are hard to read. tick 4504

Objective 7 progress bar text is clipped on the left: reads 'nbers 4/10 · Buildings 0/2' (should be 'Members 4/10'). Also the objective tracks only Members+Buildings while the era panel lists 4 conditions (Village, Members, Stalls, Day) - the objective omits Stalls 1/2 and Day 1/3. tick 4800

Build House needs a second K press / click within ~40-48 game ticks. At the 1-2 fps / 4-6 tps this machine ran, the confirm window expired five times in a row ('Not confirmed in time, so nothing was done.') before two clicks 3 s apart landed. Confirm window should be in real time or longer. ticks 6192-6672

Game ran at 1-2 fps and 4-11 tps (of 50) for the whole session on a host with load average ~94 on 20 cores. After 23 min wall clock only tick 7184 (day 1, 0.54) was reached; the Village era's Day 3 condition (~tick 60000) is roughly 2-3 hours of wall time away at this rate. All other village conditions except Members 7/10 were met by tick 6976.
